cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-829 specifically addresses importing/requiring executable functionality from untrusted sources. This code passes configuration data to Flash, not importing executable code.

connection.evidence: User-controlled options.trustedOrigins and options.trustedDomains are directly passed to Flash security configuration via flashvars parameter construction

diff_causality.evidence: The added line constructs the trustedOrigins parameter for Flash security configuration from user-provided options

security_control.evidence: Only URL encoding is applied; no validation of origin format or security constraints
security_control.required_control: Validation of security configuration values against allowlists or security policies
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: Flash security configuration requires trusted origins to be validated to prevent unauthorized domain trust
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation of origin format, protocol restrictions, or security policy compliance beyond basic encoding

concrete_impact.evidence: Potential Flash security misconfiguration, but specific exploit impact depends on Flash's interpretation and downstream validation

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the trustedOrigins configuration would not be passed to Flash, preventing potential security misconfiguration from user-controlled values.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled options.trustedOrigins and options.trustedDomains are directly incorporated into Flash security configuration
No validation beyond URL encoding is applied to the origin values
The configuration affects Flash security domain trust settings
contradicting_evidence: CWE-829 specifically addresses importing executable functionality, not configuration data
The code passes configuration parameters, not executable code or libraries
unresolved_facts: How Flash interprets and validates trustedOrigins values
Whether Flash imposes additional security constraints on origin values
Specific impact of malformed or malicious origin values on Flash security
